tara: Heads-up: I'm refreshing the Hello Quickstart to tighten auth docs + add an "opt-in" section for private/VPC customers. Main goals: 1) migrate examples to use env-driven auth (REDWOOD_AUTH_MODE), 2) include a local dev proxy compose that simulates OIDC, 3) add a short migration checklist for Dedicated.

ben: Sounds good. Can you paste the new env vars you'll show? Want to check copy/paste accuracy for SDK snippets.

tara: Yep — short snippet below (will be in a code block in the doc):

```
# recommended (private/Dedicated)
REDWOOD_AUTH_MODE=oidc
OIDC_CLIENT_ID=quickstart-local
REDWOOD_OIDC_ISSUER=https://idp.example.com
# local dev only
REDWOOD_LOCAL_PROXY=true
```

kai: For rollouts: keep the legacy API_KEY example in an appendix for 7 days. Also add a migration checklist: create OIDC client, add redirect URIs, store secret in KMS, update REDWOOD_AUTH_MODE, run smoke test.

ben: I'll pick up the CI bits: add `docs/ci/quickstart_oidc_smoke.sh` and a docs job that runs the compose override. Use the prow secret helper to inject test creds.

tara: Great. I'll open the PR and add local run steps: `docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker.compose.dev.yml up --build` + `./scripts/dev/seed_oidc.sh`. Also mention that the local proxy must never be used in prod.

docs-bot: PR opened by tara: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4921 - quickstart: env-driven auth + local proxy + CI smoke

kai: Quick nit: don't call it "auth shim" in the docs. Use "local auth proxy (dev-only)" and include the security note. Otherwise LGTM.

tara: Thanks — will update wording and merge after CI passes. Targeting merge tomorrow 09:30 PT.
